archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Final-report fallback changes stale marker and invalidation precedence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural-guidelines final-report fallback path. Verify a readable durable note with mismatched HEAD wins over stale drop markers, but consumable stale-fingerprint notes still persist a drop notice and invalidate artifacts. Check symlink and missing-artifact behavior remains conservative. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-closeout-postmerge
archetypes.rationale: Closeout pinning now uses post-merge evidence to skip repinning against main.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 16/17 pin guard in closeout. Verify post-merge detection is narrow, incomplete metadata falls through to the existing best-effort pin path, and state-file reads do not introduce blocking behavior. Check tests cover sentinel, no-sentinel, and matching-head cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
